_meta.description: Audit history for the content-audit-agent learning loop. Each entry is one post-live audit. The agent reads this file at the start of every audit to surface patterns specific to this brand.

fields.hook_type: one of: emotional_tension | curiosity_gap | bold_claim | identity_statement | visual_interrupt | social_proof | urgency_scarcity
fields.content_style: one of: ugc | founder | product_demo | problem_solution | listicle | testimonial | trending_audio | other
fields.pre_live_score: Stage 1 score if a pre-live audit was run, otherwise null
fields.platforms: object with per-platform metrics — only include platforms where data was available
fields.best_platform: platform with the strongest performance signal
fields.key_learning: 1-2 sentence insight specific to this brand — what would future-you want to know?
fields.add_to_history: true if this audit produced a meaningful learning signal

audits.hook_note: High motion opening with genuine group reaction energy, but text hook absent at 0s — critical brief miss. Text doesn't appear until ~3s.
audits.content_detail: Multi-group reaction clip — 2+ different households filmed, chaos/laughter energy throughout, Thinkle box visible from ~4.5s

penalty_flags.flag: No pattern interrupt text hook in opening window
Orange colour grade overlay transition reads as produced effect
Soft static end card — wide calm room shot violates brief's no-end-card rule
Top-down product shot with no people — retention sag at 75%

top_fixes: Add text overlay at 0s (surprising line out of context — e.g. 'I said my mum.')
Open on a tight face crop, not a wide table
Replace soft end card with hard cut to black over gameplay CTA
what_worked: Genuine unscripted reaction energy — not manufactured
Multi-group social proof signal — implies community adoption
Orange box visible and recognisable from ~4.5s without branded intro
Bold orange/white text treatment is punchy and mobile-readable
Duration 18.1s is optimal for both target platforms
audits.key_learning: For Thinkle reaction-style UGC, the raw footage quality was strong but the hook text was absent at 0s — this is an edit-level failure, not a concept failure. Brief compliance on the opening 2s is the most leveraged fix for this format. Track this: if post-live hook rate underperforms after revision, the tight-face-open execution (not just text presence) may also need to be enforced as a brief requirement.
audits.notes: First audit entry for thinkle.com.au. First submission from editor Nick. No historical baseline yet — this entry establishes the first data point for pattern learning.

audits.hook_note: Hybrid curiosity-gap / emotional tension opener. 'They're shouting between the food!?' text at frame 0 over high-motion dinner table sweep. Strongest hook across all five Melissa submissions.
audits.content_detail: Multi-family UGC problem-solution arc. Hook: family chaos/phones. Problem scene: man on phone at dinner. Commercial signal: 'This is a game that got everyone off their phones' overlay at 6.5s. Product reveal: woman on couch with Thinkle box at ~21s. Joy scenes: group celebrations across multiple households. CTA: overhead product shot with Thinkle.com.au.

v4_feedback_resolution.cta_sentence_note: URL now on own line on product shot but 'Get this now on' still reads incomplete at 27s before transition

penalty_flags.flag: Product box not visible until 21s — past 10s guideline
Heineken bottle visible in gameplay scene — brand safety / policy risk
penalty_flags.note: Flagged for editorial removal before Meta upload; no points deducted but blocks Meta publish

audits.decision: GREEN LIGHT — TikTok immediate; Meta after Heineken bottle removal

meta.publish_blocker: Heineken bottle at 0:27 — remove before Meta upload

top_fixes_for_v6: Insert brief Thinkle box visual at 8–12s to address product-after-10s penalty
Consolidate CTA to single line 'Get this now on Thinkle.com.au' at cut to overhead shot
Remove/blur Heineken bottle at ~27s — required before Meta upload, recommended for all platforms
what_worked: Strongest hook of all five Melissa submissions — 'They're shouting between the food!?' at frame 0 with high motion
V4 RGB glitch fully removed — woman-holding-Thinkle-box scene is now commercially clean
Commercial signal text overlay at 6.5s ('This is a game that got everyone off their phones') — most impactful V4 fix
Strong emotional arc: disconnection problem → product → multi-family joy → aspiration → CTA
Video ends on overhead CTA product shot — no cut away
audits.key_learning: V5 confirms that iterative feedback on Melissa's content is producing consistent improvement: 41 → 48 → 68 → 62.8 (regression) → 77.5. The regression in V4 (RGB glitch) was immediately reversible. The key learning for this format: a specific, contextual curiosity-gap hook ('They're shouting between the food!?') outperforms broad identity/emotional hooks for Thinkle. The 6.5s commercial signal text overlay is a structural element that should be standard for all future Thinkle UGC ads — it's the bridge that makes silent autoplay viable. Watch for product-visibility-before-10s as a recurring weakness in Melissa's edit style.
audits.notes: First GREEN LIGHT for Melissa across five submissions. Two publish conditions: (1) TikTok — clear to publish immediately. (2) Meta — requires Heineken bottle removal at ~27s before upload. V6 optional optimisation pass available if Harrison wants to push score to ~80+.
